_comment: Copy into a workspace directory as config.json (outside any git checkout) and fill in real values. Secrets never live here: credentials are named by env var, not stored. One agent per community workspace: give each its own workspace directory and 'agent' name so their dedupe state does not collide.

source._comment: Only the 'agentmail' transport is implemented (issue #19); 'session' (xoxc token) has a working client elsewhere but using it against a community workspace is an authorization decision not yet made, so selecting it raises. 'workspace' is a label for the Signal's source/meta fields, not a credential. Setup: turn on the workspace's own notification/digest emails and forward them to the AgentMail inbox; 'inbox' falls back to AGENTMAIL_EMAIL when omitted. 'from_contains' scopes a shared inbox to this workspace's notification sender so unrelated mail is never scored. 'channels' is a coarse substring match against subject+body (AgentMail has no structured channel field); omit for everything the digests cover. 'limit' bounds recent inbox messages per run; it is not a time window.
